name: Find It
description: Remember where things are: mark a spot ("spare keys", "the HDMI cables") and find it later from the list on your menu's Home: an arrow in front of you points the way and a marker shows the spot, even inside a drawer. Place it once per space; everyone in the space shares the list.

settings.label: Always show pins
settings.help: Small pins on every marked spot, not only the one you're finding

gestures.name: Find It
gestures.how: Menu Home → Find: tap a thing, follow the arrow
gestures.more: To mark something: on the menu's Home, under Find, tap ＋ Mark where something is, say or type what it is, then aim at the spot and pinch (or tap it on a phone). Marking a name again moves it. To find it: tap it in the list. An arrow floats in front of you pointing the way, with the distance, and a marker glows on the spot (through drawers and furniture). Walk up to it and it says found. The trash button forgets one.
